payload.stories:
SIX STORIES. Two killers, marked. Evidence sides stay empty until validation.

S1 (KILLER, realizes PROP 1 / N1, N2, N5) - THE AGENT CONSULTS WHAT THE PROCESS DEMANDS.
Slide 1: an agent is about to port a feature from v1. The porting law says check the design document AND v1's implementation first.
Slide 2: it reads the design document's relevant section - a 132k-char file - by asking for the lines it needs, in one call, and gets them.
Slide 3: it searches v1's method files by ref and gets hits WITH surrounding context, in one call.
Slide 4: it searches the record for what a closed iteration decided about the same feature, and finds evidence that exists in no working tree.
Slide 5: it builds from what the sources actually say. No script is written. The log shows what was consulted, by name.
WHY KILLER: this is the exact sequence that failed three times in i8d and produced three owner corrections. If this story does not run, the iteration bought nothing.

S2 (KILLER, realizes PROP 2 / N6, N7, N9) - A GATE JUDGES ITSELF WHERE IT CAN.
Slide 1: an agent reaches gate_implementation after a build.
Slide 2: the evidence form does NOT ask it to assert that the build filled the allocated elements - a lint has compared what the build touched against what the architecture allocated, and the verdict is already in the packet.
Slide 3: likewise for tests-observed-red and for every requirement carrying a verify_method and a breaks_if_removed.
Slide 4: the agent writes prose only where judgement is genuinely required, and self-blesses under the standing grant.
Slide 5: the owner, reading the grant days later, can see WHICH checks were computed without reading a word of the prose.
WHY KILLER: this is what makes the involvement slider reach zero safely. Without it, delegation rests on the agent's attention, which i8d demonstrated is not enough.

S3 (realizes PROP 1 / N3) - A LAW MINTED TODAY BINDS A SESSION TOMORROW.
Slide 1: a law is minted with an applies_to naming the states it governs.
Slide 2: a NEW session, with no memory of the minting, reaches such a state.
Slide 3: the packet carries the law, resolved, beside the step's own instruction - the agent did not search for it and could not have known to.
Slide 4: the agent's work conforms, because the rule arrived with the work.

S4 (realizes PROP 1 / N4) - A MECHANICAL CHANGE IS ONE CALL.
Slide 1: a constructor signature changes and six call sites must follow.
Slide 2: the agent sends one call carrying six edits, each hash-guarded.
Slide 3: it lands atomically, and the log shows one recorded, provenanced change - not a script the ledger cannot see.

S5 (realizes PROP 2 / N8) - THE RECORD SURVIVES CARELESSNESS.
Slide 1: someone deletes every iter/* tag - or pushes without the flag that carries them.
Slide 2: a closed iteration's evidence is still reachable, by hash, from trunk.
Slide 3: the record-search still answers, because reachability never depended on a name anyone could delete.

S6 (realizes PROP 2 / N7, the unhappy path) - A CHECK THAT CANNOT DECIDE DOES NOT STOP THE NIGHT.
Slide 1: an unattended iteration runs at 3am with the owner asleep.
Slide 2: it reaches a check the machine cannot compute.
Slide 3: the check DEFERS - it appears as prose in the evidence form, exactly as today.
Slide 4: the run continues and closes. Nothing waited for a human who was explicitly not there.
WHY IT MATTERS THOUGH IT IS NOT A KILLER: this is the story that keeps S2 from destroying the thing it exists to protect.
